title: Patchwork infra scratchpad
content:
Morning brain dump - rapid checklist and stray notes (working, not polished)

Toplines
- Half-day focus: free up 2x A100s in west-eu-rack-12 for dedicated bursts. Need to confirm preemption window and notify DS team.
- Observed 18% tail-latency spike on small-batch path between 02:30-03:15 UTC; triage hints at occasional NVLink flaps on nodes r12-n[03-05].

Quick TODOs (prioritized)
- [ ] Drain r12-n05, snapshot logs, trigger maintenance cordon (estimate 18m). Owner: me. Target: today EOD.
- [ ] Validate node reimage script (scripts/node-reimage.sh) on staging; try one node to verify kube-label preservation.
- [ ] Temp route: update smart-routing policy to prefer cheaper-t4-variants for non-critical async workloads (policy id: pr-async-cost-saver).
- [ ] Add KV cache TTL exception for billing-proxy requests (they hit lots of cold-cache misses).

Capacity notes + quick math
- Current A100 pool: 24 GPUs (usable 22 w/1 spare + 1 reserved). Desired burst: reserve 2 more => will need to evict 4 small jobs or shift to t4 pool.
- If we evict 4 small jobs (avg 0.6 GPUs each), we free ~2.4 GPUs. That nets enough but need manual approval from scheduling.
- Checkpoint: ping scheduling@redwood to approve preemption window (slack link above).

Networking / infra oddities observed
- NVLink warnings: kernel driver log shows repeated timeout on r12-n03 (dmesg snippet pasted in my scratch notes). Suspect hardware flake, raise HW ticket with datacenter ops.
- Intermittent pod DNS errors on node reboots (kube-dns cache not warming fast); workaround: add readinessProbe delay of 10s for proxy sidecar on restart-heavy pods.

Commands/notes to run (save these snippets)
- Drain command (safe): kubectl drain r12-n05 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=20m
- Snapshot logs: tar czf r12-n05-logs-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M).tgz /var/log/redwood/* /home/infra/diag/*
- Quick check for NVLink: nvidia-smi topo -m && nvidia-smi -q | grep -i link

Customer impact thoughts
- DS nightly evals run at 03:00 UTC; if we preempt without notice, some long eval jobs will fail. Must send heads-up and set maintenance window.
- Hosted API: small-batch latency spike currently within SLO but margin reduced. Keep watchers on 99th pct and set alert if >400ms sustained for 5m.

Open questions / reminders to self
- Can we temporarily siphon non-critical inference to west-us-2 spare racks? Latency penalty may be OK for background retraining tasks.
- Is the node-reimage script preserving NVME mapping labels? I think it drops custom labels — test on staging.
- Follow up with hw-ticket-ops: request physical check on NVLink riser for r12-n03.

Mini retrospective (yesterday)
- Positive: autoscaler handled bursty RL evaluation without manual intervention for 80% of jobs. Nice.
- Negative: one spot-eviction edge case where pod got stuck Terminating for >15m due to local emptyDir cleanup — consider adding faster forced cleanup path or extend grace period for those pods.

Messages to send (short)
- To DS slack: "Heads-up: planned maintenance on r12-n05 today; might preempt long eval jobs around EOD, will announce window shortly."
- To schedulers: "Need approval for preemption window 20:00-22:00 UTC to reclaim 2 A100s. Will cordon nodes and drain non-critical jobs first."

Risk checklist before touch
- Confirm backups for any local-only state (search for annotations backup=true).
- Verify metrics retention: ensure last 72h of perf traces saved to s3://infra-traces/r12/
- Confirm oncall tilt: @me, @Maya for escalation; #infra-ops channel monitored.

End-of-day goals
- Free 2 GPUs, post maint note, close HW ticket if NVLink confirmed.
- Validate one reimage on staging and write short playbook note in Confluence: "Reimage checklist - preserve-k8s-labels".

Random scratch ideas (brainstorm)
- Small utility: slack bot command /reserve-gpu which checks pool capacity and creates preempt request draft in scheduling. Could save 5-10 mins per eviction cycle.
- Log enrichment: auto-attach node topology output (nvidia-smi topo -m) to any infra alert for GPUs.

---
Notes-to-self end. Will tidy and extract action items into sprint ticket tomorrow morning.
